presets.name: Mixing
presets.description: Tilted 4.5 dB per octave so a full, balanced mix looks about flat, and averaged to show its overall balance.

presets.name: Flat
presets.description: No tilt: the spectrum as measured, for test tones and noise.

presets.name: Mid and side check
presets.description: The mid with the side drawn under it, to see what's stereo and where.

presets.name: Find resonances
presets.description: Fine resolution, quick averaging and six labelled peaks, to find a ringing frequency.

presets.name: Fast
presets.description: Follows every hit: a short window, little averaging, no held peaks.

presets.name: Spectrogram
presets.description: How the sound changes over the last five seconds, the newest at the top: what comes and goes, which a spectrum averages away.

presets.name: Find clicks
presets.description: A short window over two seconds, untilted: a click or a pop shows as one bright line across.

presets.name: Slow and smooth
presets.description: Long averaging, for a song's overall balance and for comparing with a reference.
